name: Lotan
title: Horite tribal chieftain in Seir
summary: Lotan was a Horite tribal chieftain (clan leader) in the land of Seir (Edom). He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as one of Seir's sons. His sister Timna became the concubine of Esau's son Eliphaz and the mother of Amalek.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as a son of Seir the Horite
keyEvents.description: Lotan is listed as one of Seir's sons, the Horite clan chiefs who lived in the land of Seir before the Edomites took over the area.

keyEvents.title: Lotan's sons are mentioned
keyEvents.description: Lotan's sons Hori and Hemam are listed in the genealogy of the Horites in the region of Seir.

keyEvents.title: Timna as Lotan's sister
keyEvents.description: Lotan's sister Timna became a concubine to Eliphaz, Esau's son, and bore Amalek. This connection links the Horites to Esau's lineage.

keyEvents.title: Lotan as a clan chief
keyEvents.description: Lotan is mentioned among the Horite clan chiefs who had their territories in the land of Seir.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Lotan's lineage and his sons Hori and Homam (a variant of Hemam) are repeated in the genealogical records of Chronicles.
